name: Amakano 2+
source:
About half a year has passed since "Amakano 2", sets in autumn. As the seasons change, and summer approaches, a new love story is about to begin.

Showing her true self as a matter of course, [b]Yuuhi[/b] is now able to spend her age-appropriate youth together as lovers.

Despite aiming for affection straightforwardly as a lover, becoming interested in her classmates, [b]Rei[/b]'s world around her has expanded a little.

While attending college, acting like an older sister as before, the relationship as lovers with [b]Chitose[/b], continues to be deepened.

And one more, attending the school as a first-year student, a new love story with [b]Sara[/b].

Along with this new encounter, each affection gradually grows in the dazzling summer. Eventually, this feeling becomes the driving force to take a step from just a lover towards being bounded together in the future, marriage.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/amakano2-plus/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
距离以秋天为背景的《天野2》已经过去了大约半年。随着季节的变化，夏天的临近，一段新的爱情故事即将开始。

理所当然地展现出真实的自我，[b]悠日[/b]现在可以作为恋人一起度过适龄的青春了。

尽管以恋人的身份直接追求感情，对同学产生了兴趣，[b]Rei[/b]的世界还是扩大了一些。

上大学期间，一如既往地表现得像姐姐一样，与[b]千岁[/b]的恋人关系不断加深。

还有一个，作为一年级学生上学，与[b]萨拉[/b]的新爱情故事。

伴随着这次新的邂逅，每一份感情在耀眼的夏日里逐渐生长。最终，这种感觉成为了从恋人走向未来婚姻的动力。

[翻译编辑自[url=http://azarashi-soft.nexton-net.jp/amakano2-plus/#story]官方网站[/url]]
